title: R2 fixes: port.c correctness (tag, hash-algo, IV, pool, overflow)
description:
Five correctness fixes in crypto2dev_port.c:
1. AES-GCM GET_TAG: check tag_op.taglen == authTagSz after ioctl or error
2. hash_algo_name: return NULL (and caller returns BAD_FUNC_ARG) for unknown digest sizes instead of silently returning sha256
3. Partial IV copy: zero full AES_BLOCK_SIZE of aes->reg before XMEMCPY when auxSz < AES_BLOCK_SIZE
4. Pool retirement: when re-open fails in pool_release, set in_use=0 so slot can be retried (not permanently retired)
5. HMAC Update: guard dataSz+inSz against word32 overflow before XMALLOC
